data.summary: This phone suits photography lovers and binge-watchers. Its strongest points are the RAM and display (8 GB RAM: great multitasking and 6.4" OLED display). Keep in mind: the OS is fair (ColorOS 6 (Android 9)). Android 9 is old: some new apps and security fixes will not reach it.

specs.title: Qualcomm Snapdragon 712 AIE: Upper mid-range Snapdragon
specs.meaning: Capable chip: everyday apps fly and most games run well.

specs.title: 8 GB RAM: great multitasking
specs.meaning: Great multitasking: keeps many apps open and handles demanding games well.

specs.title: 128 GB storage
specs.meaning: Room for roughly 30,000 photos (about 4 MB each) after the system files.

specs.title: 6.4" OLED display
specs.meaning: Big screen, great for videos and games. OLED panel: true blacks and vivid colours, and dark mode saves battery. Full HD sharpness: text and video look crisp.

specs.value: Quad: 64 MP f/1.8 + 8 MP ultra-wide + 2 MP macro + 2 MP depth
specs.title: 64 MP quad camera
specs.meaning: 4 rear cameras led by a 64 MP main sensor. Ultra-wide lens fits more into group shots and landscapes. A wide f/1.8 aperture lets in more light for low-light photos. The extra 2 MP depth/macro lenses add little real quality.

specs.title: 16 MP front camera
specs.meaning: Detailed selfies and clear video calls.

specs.title: 4,000 mAh battery
specs.meaning: A full day of normal use.

specs.title: 20W charging
specs.meaning: Standard fast charging: roughly half a battery in 30 to 40 minutes.

specs.title: 4G LTE
specs.meaning: Fast browsing, streaming and video calls on all major networks. Dual SIM lets you use two numbers, e.g. personal and work.

specs.title: ColorOS 6 (Android 9)
specs.meaning: Android 9 is old: some new apps and security fixes will not reach it. ColorOS is the maker's own look and features on top of Android.

specs.title: 3 year warranty
specs.meaning: Defects in the first 3 years are fixed or replaced for free.
